# Variable `FIT_CONF_PREFIX`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

When using the kernel-fitimage, this is the prefix used for creating FIT configuration nodes. Its default value is “conf-“.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-FIT_CONF_PREFIX
